newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Loony Party celebrates a day early.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Loony Party celebrates a day early.

text.p: Britain's Official Monster Raving Loony Party will be holding its victory party on Wednesday night -- 24 hours before polls close in Thursday's general election.

Chief loony Screaming Lord Sutch, former pop singer and now the country's longest-serving political party leader who usually campaigns in a leopardskin tailcoat and top hat, said celebrating a day early was a long-held party tradition.
Sutch and fellow loony stalwarts -- their election slogan is "Vote for Insanity, You Know it Makes Sense" -- planned to gather in a central London pub for a drink, or several.
"We often find other parties send their workers to our parties -- especially as most of them won't have much to celebrate after election day," Sutch said.
Sutch himself is not contesting the May 1 election because he needs to look after his aged mother, who is in hospital recovering from a hip replacement operation.
The party, the most colourful and most durable of Britain's multitude of fringe groups, has put up several candidates -- the exact number is unclear.
It is the first general election Sutch has not fought since 1964.
